explanation: The lemma says a weakly divergence-free field F (tested against compactly supported smooth ψ with support in U) stays weakly divergence-free after translation by c. Its test functions are the library's own SmoothScalar type. It needs a translation of test functions, a support check and a change of variables. The proof uses Mathlib's integral_add_right_eq_self and fderiv_comp_add_right. These are only ingredients. I found no Mathlib declaration about translating weak divergence-free fields or distributional derivatives. This was a search by name and content, not an exhaustive one, so it doesn't prove there is no match.
